interface.longDescription: Plan, build and render motion graphics from code: kinetic type, titles and logos, explainers, product and app films, data animation. Includes a motion workshop with default values and a decision table, frame-by-frame QA and designed sound. Works standalone or as FrameCore Works Creative Studio's motion companion. Rendering needs code execution with Node.js, FFmpeg and a browser, or a shell.
